$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: A Grok Build subagent's metadata
description: Grok Build's ~/.grok/sessions/<encoded cwd>/<session id>/subagents/<subagent id>/meta.json: a subagent the session ran, with its own session's id, its type and what it was asked to do. Only the fields XenoNet reads are declared: never its prompt or output. The file carries no version, so the newest schema reads it.

child_session_id.description: The subagent's own session, in the sessions folder like any other

subagent_type.description: general-purpose, explore, plan, or one of your own agents

description.description: What it was asked to do, in a few words
